outcome.name: surveillance_bounded_first_observed_onset
outcome.primary_sensor: S-NPP VIIRS VNP14IMG.002 paired with VNP03IMG.002

exposures.accessibility: 2014 equal-weight road and settlement accessibility; dated assets required
exposures.transformation: fraction of 2014 natural forest converted in t-3 through t-1 using frozen MapBiomas Indonesia 4.1 class crosswalk

vegetation.baseline: MapBiomas Indonesia 2014 natural-forest class and fraction
vegetation.current_primary: MOD13Q1.061 EVI; QA-accepted 16-day composite ending before qualifying prior-negative cutoff
vegetation.current_sensitivity: HLSL30.002/HLSS30.002 NDMI; QA-clear observations during prior 30 complete days ending before qualifying prior-negative cutoff

roles.total_accessibility: exclude post-2014 EVI and NDMI as plausible mediators
roles.transformation: exclude vegetation measured during or after t-3 through t-1; pre-exposure EVI t-6 through t-4 sensitivity only
roles.joint_mediator_adjusted: include current QA-valid EVI and NDMI

enso.primary_index: NOAA CPC ERSSTv6 Relative Oceanic Nino Index (RONI)
enso.timing: latest complete three-month season ending before the analysis cutoff
enso.exact_overpass_role: main effect conditioned out by matched-set intercept; interactions exploratory only
enso.complete_panel_role: separate climate panel; do not use exact year-month fixed effects when estimating RONI
enso.real_time_rule: historical CPC data vintages are required before any operational forecast claim

monitoring.post_end_rule: truncate S-NPP-only monitoring or use a separately calibrated NOAA-20/NOAA-21 bridge
